captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a professional telephoto zoom lens with a long, stepped cylindrical barrel. The main barrel sections are finished in off-white, contrasted by black rubberized grip rings for focusing and zooming, a dark gray tripod collar, and a thin red decorative ring near the front. The front element features a dark reflective glass lens, and the rear has a light gray mount cap. The focus ring near the front and the zoom ring near the rear rotate on revolute joints, while the tripod collar and its integrated mounting foot can rotate continuously around the center of the barrel.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a telephoto zoom lens with a stepped barrel, a front focus ring, a rear zoom ring, and a tripod collar with a mounting foot. Make the barrel off-white with black rings and a red accent band, and configure the focus ring, zoom ring, and tripod collar to rotate on revolute or continuous joints around the main cylinder axis.
captions.factory: The lens is constructed by defining a series of concentric cylinders for the main barrel sections, the front glass element, and the rear mount. Separate cylindrical parts are modeled for the focus ring, zoom ring, and tripod collar, with the tripod collar also incorporating a boolean-joined box for the mounting foot. These parts are then assembled along a common Z-axis using revolute and continuous articulations to allow independent rotation about the central axis.
